Termos.title: Terms of Use
Termos.paragraph1: Cerâmica Hub is an independent platform, developed by Geez Marketing, that connects and promotes businesses located at Espaço Cerâmica. By registering or browsing the platform, you agree to these terms.
Termos.paragraph2: Business registrations go through verification before publication. The platform may refuse, suspend or remove registrations that contain incorrect or incomplete information, or that violate these terms.
Termos.paragraph3: The information published on business pages is the responsibility of the registered business. Cerâmica Hub is not responsible for negotiations, products or services contracted between visitors and businesses.
Termos.paragraph4: These terms may be updated at any time. Relevant changes will be communicated to registered businesses.
Termos.paragraph5: Questions about these terms can be sent through the <contactLink>contact</contactLink> page.

Privacidade.title: Privacy Policy
Privacidade.paragraph1: We only collect the data needed to operate the directory: business registration information (name, contact, location, category) and basic platform usage data (such as views and contact clicks), used for the reports shown to the business itself.
Privacidade.paragraph2: A business's contact details (WhatsApp, Instagram, website) are displayed publicly on its business page, since that's the purpose of registering. Internal data such as passwords and verification documents are never displayed publicly.
Privacidade.paragraph3: We do not sell or share data with third parties for advertising purposes. Access to administrative data is restricted to the team responsible for the platform.
Privacidade.paragraph4: A business may request the correction or removal of its data at any time through the <contactLink>contact</contactLink> page.

PoliticaCadastro.metaTitle: Registration and Verification Policy — Cerâmica Hub
PoliticaCadastro.title: Registration and Verification Policy
PoliticaCadastro.paragraph1: Only businesses and professionals verifiably established at Espaço Cerâmica can have a member profile on Cerâmica Hub. During registration, the business provides its tower, floor and room, and may be asked for proof of operation at that address.
PoliticaCadastro.paragraph2: Every registration goes through review before publication. The platform may approve, request changes to, refuse, or suspend a registration that contains incorrect or incomplete information, or that fails to prove real installation at the complex. There is no guaranteed review timeframe.
PoliticaCadastro.paragraph3: Businesses external to Espaço Cerâmica do not receive a member seal and cannot be presented as part of the complex, even if they purchase advertising on the platform (see Advertising Policy).
PoliticaCadastro.paragraph4: Questions about the verification process can be sent through the <contactLink>contact</contactLink> page.

PoliticaPublicidade.title: Advertising Policy
PoliticaPublicidade.paragraph1: Cerâmica Hub may display paid content from businesses external to Espaço Cerâmica, in the form of advertising, sponsorship or campaigns. All paid content is clearly labeled as "Sponsored".
PoliticaPublicidade.paragraph2: Paid advertising does not grant member status or any indication that the advertiser is physically established at the complex — this distinction is always preserved, regardless of the amount invested.
PoliticaPublicidade.paragraph3: The platform may refuse, pause or remove a campaign at any time, without prior notice, if the content violates these terms, applicable law, or the interests of the complex's member businesses.
PoliticaPublicidade.paragraph4: Interested advertisers can get in touch through the <contactLink>contact</contactLink> page.

PoliticaCancelamento.title: Cancellation Policy
PoliticaCancelamento.paragraph1: A business may cancel a paid plan at any time. Cancellation stops renewal — paid plan features remain available until the end of the already-paid period, after which the business automatically returns to the free plan.
PoliticaCancelamento.paragraph2: Cancellation does not delete the business's profile: the registration and history continue to exist, just with free-plan features.
PoliticaCancelamento.paragraph3: Refunds, where applicable, follow current law and are evaluated case by case — the platform does not promise automatic refunds outside of legally required cases.
PoliticaCancelamento.paragraph4: Cancellation requests can be made through the business's own dashboard or through the <contactLink>contact</contactLink> page.
